subject: The target-platform claim has no run behind it, nowhere to record one, and no gate that needs one
recordedOccasion: after the owner asked what would resolve a disclosure every session repeats.
severity: F1 is low and permanent — no session can ever close it, which is the part worth writing down. F2 is the one that costs: with nowhere to record a target run, the first one ever performed would have been lost, and it produced the only cross-platform evidence this repository has.
feltAt: every session metadata.md and every handover report since Revision 206
scope: session management for the rule, the toolkit set for the platform it names. 0039 D2's split applied to verification.
read: the owner's macOS run of three checkers, 2026-09-09

findings.statement: No session can reach the target platform, and the disclosure that says so is repeated where it cannot apply
findings.sectionHeading: F1 — the gap is real, permanent, and mostly already closed

findings.statement: A run on the target platform has nowhere to be recorded, so the first one ever performed nearly was not
findings.sectionHeading: F2 — the first target run had nowhere to go

resolution.whatWasDone: docs/ledgers/target-platform-verification.md created, carrying the 2026-09-09 run of three checkers under /bin/bash 3.2.57 on arm64-apple-darwin25 against commit 4b721e7, with all eighteen values and the Linux comparison

findings.statement: Nothing requires a target-platform run before a script finding may be resolved

decisions.decision: The disclosure is scoped: metadata.md always records the environment, and a report carries the untested-on-target sentence only when the change set contains a bin/ or .internal/ executable
decisions.sectionHeading: D1 — say it where it can bite, and nowhere else

decisions.decision: A target-platform run is recorded in docs/ledgers/target-platform-verification.md: date, commit, platform, shell version, what was run and every value, beside the same run on the session platform
decisions.sectionHeading: D2 — the run gets a home, and the home is a ledger

decisions.decision: A finding whose scope includes an executable may not go resolved until a target-platform run is recorded for it. A record write owes nothing
decisions.sectionHeading: D3 — a gate, not a disclaimer

edges.why: F5 was inferred from a Linux run and is confirmed on the target by the run this bundle records
a resolved script finding asserts something about a platform nothing examines, which is F5's shape one layer out

indexNotes: Recorded and owned 2026-09-09 at the owner's direction. Carries the repository's only cross-platform verification evidence
